scripts/trace.mjs reads a requirement ID such as F16-REQ-029a as its parent F16-REQ-029. Change ID_SOURCE so an ID may end in one optional lowercase sub-ID letter, but only when that letter does not run into another letter or digit (so 'F16-REQ-029and' and 'F16-REQ-029ab' both read as F16-REQ-029). Sub-IDs are their own IDs. A range ('X to Y', plain and bracketed) expands only when neither end is a sub-ID. cmpId stays exported and orders a parent before its sub-IDs, and sub-IDs alphabetically. Add tests for this to scripts/trace.test.mjs. Separately, `node scripts/trace.mjs --check` reports C-NFR-005 as defined in two specs: docs/prd/v2/features/F18-analytics.md defines it a second time (F17 owns it): take it out of F18's ID column and say in that row's text that C-NFR-005 is defined once, in F17. Then regenerate docs/TRACE.md with `node scripts/trace.mjs`.

tasks.instruction: Three backup tests, apps/mobile/test/backup-e2e.test.ts, backup-queue.test.ts and backup-format.test.ts, assert that no uploaded body or sealed object contains the four bytes 'ftyp'. The bodies are random ciphertext, so four bytes match by chance now and then and CI flakes. In each file, replace that 4-byte check with a check that the recording's own first 16 bytes (its ftyp box header) appear at no offset, and assert that the fixture really has 'ftyp' at bytes 4 to 8. Keep every other leak check as it is. Change only these three test files.

In Review's 'With small fixes' view, Transcript (apps/mobile/src/components/capture/transcript.tsx) draws a space in front of a closing mark after struck words: 'Today you held the spoon, um.' shows 'spoon ~~, um~~ .'. Add and export a pure function `struckGaps(prev: string | undefined, text: string, next: string | undefined): [string, string]` in apps/mobile/src/components/capture/transcript.logic.ts. It returns the spaces to draw before and after a struck run: a space before only when prev exists, does not end in whitespace, and the struck text does not start with a closing mark (one of , . ; : ! ? ) ]); a space after only when next exists, does not start with whitespace, and does not start with a closing mark. An opening quote is not a closing mark. Use it in transcript.tsx wherever the struck run's spaces are drawn, in place of the current gap logic. Display only: change nothing in packages/core.

Build 2's TestFlight 'What to test' text (whatToTest.build2 in packages/content/src/release/testflight.en.ts) tells testers 'To delete your account and its letters, use Settings, Delete account.' The row is hidden in both alpha builds unless EXPO_PUBLIC_ACCOUNT_DELETION is on (D-129), so the sentence is false whenever the row is hidden. Make whatToTest.build2 the text without that sentence (the default). Add whatToTest.build2WithDeleteRow: the same text with the sentence, byte-identical to today's build 2 text. Add testflightCopy.deleteAccountLine: that sentence as a named piece, ending with Settings and the Delete account row label from en.settingsHome.deleteAccountLabel. Build both texts from one private function so they differ by that sentence only. Do not write a replacement sentence for the hidden case. In docs/release/TESTFLIGHT.md, say which of the two texts to paste for which build. Update packages/content/test/testflight.test.ts for the new shape.
